results.title: Cloudflare Says GLM-5.3 Bug Leaked 155 Responses Across Tenant Sessions – Unite.AI
results.description: Cloudflare on October 26, 2026 published an incident report disclosing a cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 model on its Workers AI platform, under which 155 responses to very long prompts contained data from other customers’ sessions. Security researcher Gadi Evron of Knostic reported the tenant-isolation issue to Cloudflare on September 8, 2026 ...

results.title: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model, and our remediation with SGLang | Cloudflare Blog
results.description: On September 8, 2026, we were alerted by a security researcher, Gadi Evron from Knostic, to a tenant isolation issue affecting the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model (@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3) starting on August 27, 2026.

results.title: Cloudflare discloses a fixed GLM-5.3 cache exposure affecting 155 responses | OpenTools
results.description: The report was published October 26, but the exposure window was August 27 through September 9, 2026. Cloudflare says it remediated the issue and restored the model on September 9.

results.title: Cloudflare Says KV Cache Bug Leaked 155 GLM-5.3 Responses | AI Weekly
